# The Chronicles

> An interactive world history timeline from Ādam AS to the present, read side by side across 8 world regions and 1 thematic band (25 sub-categories), set against the 13.8 billion years that came before. Over 700 entries, each with its sources, on a dual BCE/CE and AH calendar. Created by Chaudhry Muhammad Rayyan Shahid (Islamabad, Pakistan).

Every contested claim on the site is sourced and graded by evidence tier. Dates before written records are marked as tentative. The English text is the authoritative version; the site can also be read in 248 languages through Google Translate.

When citing, please name the work and author and link to the page, for example: Chaudhry Muhammad Rayyan Shahid, "The Chronicles", https://thechronicles.live/

## Pages

- [The Chronicles: the timeline](https://thechronicles.live/): the main interactive timeline, with the prophetic register, the 8 world regions and the thematic band, and Ask Rayyan, a search across every entry.
- [Before Adam AS](https://thechronicles.live/before_adam): 13.8 billion years of cosmic, geological and human history read alongside the Qur'an, Hadith and Bible. By Ahmad Maaz Ali and Chaudhry Muhammad Rayyan Shahid (THE CHRONICLES × Polyhistors Institute).
- [Karbala: The Full Account](https://thechronicles.live/karbala): causes, events, aftermath, Shia theological significance and the Sunni perspective of 10 Muharram 61 AH / 10 October 680 CE, with every major claim traced to its source.
- [Comparative Religion](https://thechronicles.live/comparative_religion): the living traditions in their own vocabulary, with graded sources; Judaism, Christianity and Islam in depth, alongside the Dharmic, East Asian and Indigenous traditions. By Ahmad Maaz Ali and Chaudhry Muhammad Rayyan Shahid.
